answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 14 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 290 identities costs 290 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The tide of the design is public, the willow of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the horizon of honest work is what finally pays.
